# Docusaurus

> Docusaurus is an open-source static site generator for documentation websites, built with React and MDX. It ships versioned docs, blogs, i18n, search, and theming out of the box. These docs cover installation, configuration, the docs/blog/pages content plugins, markdown features, deployment, and the plugin API.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://docusaurus.io/docs/installation): Scaffold a site with create-docusaurus and understand the project structure
- [Configuration](https://docusaurus.io/docs/configuration): What goes in docusaurus.config.js and how config is organized
- [Playground](https://docusaurus.io/docs/playground): Try Docusaurus in the browser
- [TypeScript support](https://docusaurus.io/docs/typescript-support): Use TypeScript for config and components

## Guides

- [Docs introduction](https://docusaurus.io/docs/docs-introduction): The docs feature — sidebars, folder structure, and routing
- [Create a doc](https://docusaurus.io/docs/create-doc): Write your first documentation page
- [Sidebar](https://docusaurus.io/docs/sidebar): Configure sidebars, including autogenerated ones
- [Versioning](https://docusaurus.io/docs/versioning): Maintain docs for multiple product versions
- [Blog](https://docusaurus.io/docs/blog): The built-in blog — authors, tags, and feeds
- [Creating pages](https://docusaurus.io/docs/creating-pages): Standalone React and markdown pages
- [Markdown features](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features): MDX, front matter, and everything markdown supports
- [Code blocks](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/code-blocks): Syntax highlighting, line highlighting, and live code
- [Admonitions](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/admonitions): Note, tip, warning, and danger callouts
- [Tabs](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/tabs): Tabbed content in markdown
- [Assets](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/assets): Images and files in markdown
- [Links](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/links): Linking between docs
- [Table of contents](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/toc): Headings and inline TOC configuration
- [Diagrams](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/diagrams): Mermaid diagrams in markdown
- [Math equations](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/math-equations): KaTeX math rendering
- [Head metadata](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/head-metadata): Per-page metadata and social cards
- [Styling and layout](https://docusaurus.io/docs/styling-layout): CSS, theming, and dark mode
- [Swizzling](https://docusaurus.io/docs/swizzling): Customize theme components safely
- [Static assets](https://docusaurus.io/docs/static-assets): The static folder and how files are served
- [Using plugins](https://docusaurus.io/docs/using-plugins): Install and configure plugins and presets
- [Search](https://docusaurus.io/docs/search): Algolia DocSearch and local search options
- [SEO](https://docusaurus.io/docs/seo): Metadata, sitemaps, and social cards
- [Deployment](https://docusaurus.io/docs/deployment): Build and deploy to GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, and more
- [i18n introduction](https://docusaurus.io/docs/i18n/introduction): Translate your site
- [CLI](https://docusaurus.io/docs/cli): docusaurus start, build, deploy, and friends
- [Docs multi-instance](https://docusaurus.io/docs/docs-multi-instance): Multiple docs sections in one site
- [Browser support](https://docusaurus.io/docs/browser-support): Supported browsers and browserslist config
- [Migration](https://docusaurus.io/docs/migration): Upgrade between Docusaurus major versions

## API reference

- [docusaurus.config.js](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/docusaurus-config): Every site config option
- [Plugin methods](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugin-methods): Lifecycle APIs for plugin authors
- [Plugins overview](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins): All official plugins
- [plugin-content-docs](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs): Docs plugin options
- [plugin-content-blog](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-content-blog): Blog plugin options
- [plugin-content-pages](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-content-pages): Pages plugin options
- [plugin-sitemap](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-sitemap): Sitemap plugin options
- [plugin-client-redirects](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects): Client-side redirects
- [Themes overview](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/themes): Official themes
- [theme-classic](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/themes/@docusaurus/theme-classic): Classic theme options
- [Docusaurus core API](https://docusaurus.io/docs/docusaurus-core): React APIs available to your components
- [Core ESLint plugin](https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/misc/@docusaurus/eslint-plugin): ESLint rules for Docusaurus sites
